summary: Corrected CUDA-graph pipeline proxy views to use rank-local token rows at SCATTERED attention-TP boundaries in capture, replay output, and dummy warmup. The invariant is covered by a failing-before/passing-after regression and was numerically checked on the assigned gfx950 GPU, but the original 8x gfx942 GLM-5.3 workload was unavailable.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: collection failed because the rank-local PP proxy row-count implementation did not exist. Raw output: reports/j-7cbd25e19382/raw/failing_before_pp_proxy_token_count.txt

57 tests passed, covering scattered/full PP row counts, invalid boundary inputs, decode graph behavior, and graph buffer registry behavior. Raw output: reports/j-7cbd25e19382/raw/decode_graph_suite_final.txt

On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, a 32-row TP=4 boundary produced 8 rank-local rows; GPU sum 1540.0 matched the independent NumPy sum 1540.0. Raw output: reports/j-7cbd25e19382/raw/gpu_pp_proxy_boundary.txt
Changed Python files passed import sorting, lint, and formatting checks.

remaining_limitations: The original reproduction requires 8x MI300X gfx942 with TP=4 and PP=2; only one MI350X gfx950 was assigned.
The zai-org/GLM-5.3 753B FP8 weights were unavailable.
No end-to-end multi-chunk serving reproduction was claimed.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot validate DSA/GLM semantics or distributed PP and was therefore not treated as a substitute.
The change is Python-only; no native rebuild was applicable.
